# Laser Craft: Precision laser cutting and woodworking designs generated by code.

This project collects laser cutting and woodworking designs generated programmatically using [FreeCAD](https://www.freecad.org/) Python scripts, built and executed with [Bazel](https://bazel.build/) and [rules_freecad](https://github.com/Programming-Rivers/rules_freecad).

The project exports vector graphics (such as `.svg` cut and engrave profiles) dimensioned and laid out for laser cutters (e.g. Epilog Legend 36EXT and Epilog Mini 24).

---

## Features & Included Designs

- **Rattles (`//rattles:owl`)**:
  - Parametric owl-shaped baby rattle outline with custom Bézier splines and feature cutouts.
  - Outputs `owl_rattle.svg` scaled for standard bed dimensions.
- **Milestones (`//milestones:birth_milestones`)**:
  - Baby birth milestone marker rounds with text typography (incorporating downloaded fonts like Funnel Sans and Tangerine via Bazel runfiles).
  - Generates layered engraving and cutting profiles.
- **Puzzles (`//puzzles:abcpzl`)**:
  - Alphabet puzzle cutouts and placement layouts.
- **Geometry Library (`//geometry:bezier`)**:
  - Reusable geometry utilities, including cubic Bézier curve point calculation and FreeCAD Draft BSpline curve generation.
- **Fonts (`//fonts:*`)**:
  - Bazel rules managing font dependencies (*Open Sans*, *Funnel Sans*, *Tangerine*) fetched through Bazel HTTP rules.

---

## Prerequisites

- **Bazel** (or [Bazelisk](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazelisk)): Bazel 8+ with Bzlmod support enabled.
- **NO other requirement**: Everything required for running this project is managed by Bazel and will be downloaded (and cached) upon first run.
---

## Configuration

To avoid passing platform flags manually for every build or execution, configure `.bazelrc.user`:

1. Copy the template:
   ```bash
   cp .bazelrc.user.template .bazelrc.user
   ```
2. Update `.bazelrc.user` with your target platform if not already set, for example:
   ```ini
   common --platforms=@rules_freecad//platforms:freecad_linux_x86_64
   ```

---

## Running Designs

Run any of the design targets using `bazel run`:

### Owl Rattle
```bash
bazel run //rattles:owl
```
Generates `owl_rattle.svg` in the project root.

### Birth Milestones
```bash
bazel run //milestones:birth_milestones
```
Generates SVG milestone templates using embedded fonts.

### Alphabet Puzzle
```bash
bazel run //puzzles:abcpzl
```
